name: Wall slide
feels: can't line up a wall jump
summary: Falling while pushing into a wall slows the fall, giving the player time to line up a wall jump.
what_it_does: Without a slide, a player who reaches a wall falls past it at full speed and has a split second to react. A wall slide caps fall speed while the player is in the air, moving down, and holding toward a wall they touch. Celeste starts the cap very low and lets it rise back to normal fall speed over about a second, so nobody can hang forever.
use_when: Games with wall jumps or vertical shafts.
watch_out: Only slide while the player holds toward the wall, or they snag on every wall they brush past.
starting_values: Celeste's public player code starts the slide cap at 20 (40 px/s at this demo's size) and blends it back to the normal max fall speed over 1.2 seconds of sliding.
prompt:
Add a wall slide.
- While in the air, moving down, and holding toward a wall the player touches: cap fall speed.
- The cap starts at 40 px/s and rises linearly to the normal max fall speed over 1200 ms of sliding.
- Reset the slide timer on landing or jumping.
- No slide when not holding toward the wall.

Acceptance checks:
1. Holding into a wall while falling slows the fall to about 40 px/s at first.
2. After 1200 ms of sliding, fall speed is back to normal.
3. Brushing past a wall without holding toward it does not slow the fall.
